children.title: Degree-asymmetric pointed pair (Theorem T+) is reconstructible
children.statement_en: Theorem T+ (degree-asymmetric pointed pair, t3.md section 5): every graph G on at least 3 vertices with u ≠ v such that (i) deg u − deg v is not −[u~v] or 1 − [u~v]; (ii) the ordered pairs (x, y), x ≠ y, with G − x − y ≅ G − u − v that are neither pointed-card equivalent to (u, v) (an isomorphism G − x → G − u mapping y to v) nor to the reverse (y', x') of such a pair are fewer than the pairs pointed-card equivalent to (u, v); (iii) for every pair (x, y) pointed-card equivalent to (u, v), every automorphism of G − x − y preserves G-degrees; is reconstructible.

children.title: Symmetric pointed pair (Theorem T) is reconstructible
children.statement_en: Theorem T (symmetric pointed pair, t3.md section 4): every graph G on at least 3 vertices with u ≠ v such that some isomorphism G − u → G − v maps v to u, the ordered pairs (x, y), x ≠ y, with G − x − y ≅ G − u − v that are not pointed-card equivalent to (u, v) are fewer than those that are, and every automorphism of G − u − v preserves G-degrees, is reconstructible.

children.title: Unique switch at a nonsingular vertex (Theorem U) is reconstructible
children.statement_en: Theorem U (unique switch, t1.md section 4): every graph G on at least 3 vertices that is two-walk (a, b)-linear for integers a, b (the sum of the degrees of the neighbours of x is a·deg x + b for every x), with a vertex u' such that A_G f = (a − deg u') f has no nonzero integer solution f, and with a card isomorphism α : G − u → G − u' and a neighbour x of u such that α(x) is not adjacent to u', is reconstructible.

children.title: Residual: diameter-2 residual remainder outside T+, T and US
